skill.name: search-specialist
skill.description: Guides structured web research with advanced search queries, result filtering, source verification, and synthesis for trend analysis, fact-checking, and competitive research.
skill.summary: Research assistant for query planning, source evaluation, fact-checking, and evidence synthesis.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: The only static finding is a false positive from Markdown inline code around a resource path. No executable commands, prompt injection attempts, or malicious intent were found in SKILL.md.

static_findings.snippet: - If detailed examples are required, open `resources/implementation-playbook.md`.

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 26 uses Markdown backticks around the file path resources/implementation-playbook.md. It is instructional prose, not Ruby shell execution or an executable command.

content.value_statement: Research tasks often produce scattered results and unclear source quality. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through structured searches, verification, and synthesis.
actual_capabilities: Creates focused search query variations for broad and narrow discovery.
Filters results by domain, time period, and source type.
Evaluates source credibility and ranks useful results.
Cross-checks claims across multiple sources before synthesis.
Reports contradictions, gaps, and recommended next searches.
limitations: Requires browsing or search tools to access current web content.
Cannot verify private sources unless the user provides access.
May need user guidance for niche domains or preferred source lists.
Does not replace legal, medical, or financial expert review.

use_cases.title: Validate Market Claims
use_cases.description: Compare public sources, competitor pages, and reports before using claims in planning documents.

use_cases.title: Build Source Briefs
use_cases.description: Gather credible links, quotes, and context for articles, briefs, or internal research notes.

use_cases.title: Check Technical Facts
use_cases.description: Confirm release details, documentation changes, and technical claims across primary sources.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Topic Search
prompt_templates.prompt: Research this topic and return the strongest sources, key findings, and any open questions: [topic].
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when starting a general research task.

prompt_templates.title: Source Quality Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these sources for credibility, relevance, and conflicts. Explain which sources should be trusted most: [sources].
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when you already have links or citations.

prompt_templates.title: Competitive Research
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare these competitors on positioning, features, pricing signals, and recent changes. Include search queries used: [competitors].
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when preparing market or product analysis.

prompt_templates.title: Evidence Synthesis
prompt_templates.prompt: Investigate this claim across primary and secondary sources. Separate confirmed facts, disputed points, and evidence gaps: [claim].
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when accuracy and traceable evidence matter.

output_examples.input: Find reliable sources on recent adoption trends for passkeys.
output: Search plan with query variations and source priorities.
Short list of vendor, standards, and analyst sources.
Synthesis of adoption signals, gaps, and next research steps.

output_examples.input: Check whether a competitor recently changed its pricing.
output: Timeline of visible pricing changes with source links.
Confidence assessment for each observed change.
Notes on missing evidence and suggested monitoring queries.

best_practices: Provide the research goal, location, date range, and required source types.
Ask for primary sources when claims need strong evidence.
Request contradictions and gaps so weak evidence is visible.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for a final answer without source links.
Do not treat a single search result as verified evidence.
Do not use the skill for private databases without access details.

faq.question: Does this skill search the live web by itself?
faq.answer: It guides the assistant to use available browsing or search tools. Current results depend on the host environment.

faq.question: Can it help with fact-checking?
faq.answer: Yes. It asks for multiple sources, source quality checks, contradictions, and clear evidence gaps.

faq.question: Can I use it for competitive analysis?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports competitor comparisons, pricing signals, positioning research, and trend checks.

faq.question: Does it require coding knowledge?
faq.answer: No. The prompts work for general research, product work, writing, and technical checks.

faq.question: What should I provide for best results?
faq.answer: Provide the research question, audience, preferred sources, exclusions, region, and time range.

faq.question: Is it safe for sensitive topics?
faq.answer: Use it for source discovery and synthesis. Get expert review for medical, legal, or financial decisions.
